say:0:1710326001:0.text: The collapsed statue bears marks of a heavy impact, with the force focused on one spot.
say:0:1710326001:0.source_cn: 这具倒下的雕像上有重物撞击的痕迹，力量很大，但作用的点...

say:2:1710326002:1.text: This mark... it looks like Father struck the statue hard with his shield.
say:2:1710326002:1.source_cn: 这处被重物撞击的痕迹……很像父亲的盾击造成的。
say:2:1710326002:1.male: This mark... it looks like Father struck the statue hard with his shield.
